stock.description: Serving as an investment holding company, China Health Group Limited engages in a diverse range of operations. Within the People's Republic of China, its core business involves the supply and maintenance of medical equipment and disposables, coupled with the administration and operation of healthcare facilities. The company also extends its activities into commercial factoring and real estate investment. Previously operating under the name China HealthCare Holdings Limited, the company officially adopted "China Health Group Limited" in September 2015. Its principal office is located in Central, Hong Kong.
